text:
Over a relaxed start, the planning crew brought up an idea about handover notes, and we are very sorry that your companion animal was not handled with the care and clarity you expected during your journey with Aurelia Skyways. We understand that your complaint concerns delays, a stressful handover, and concern that the support provided by the Companion Animal Travel Desk did not protect your animal's comfort and safety.

As a safety reviewer, I have looked at the matter with attention to the transfer steps, the lounge handling, and the communication trail. The account you raised shows gaps in coordination between booking, airport care, and pickup, and those gaps should not occur. We apologize for the distress this caused and for any sense that your concerns were not taken seriously at the point when they were first reported.

<<FACT F113>>

The purpose of our review is not only to address the immediate incident but also to reduce the chance of repeat harm. In this case, the handling notes should have been complete, the staff briefing should have been consistent, and any change in your companion animal's status should have been passed along without hesitation. We are reinforcing those expectations with the teams that assist travelers with animals, and we are reminding them that calm, accurate communication is part of safe care, not an optional extra.

<<FACT F119>>

If you have already shared veterinary information, behavior notes, or photos from the arrival process, please keep those records available with your claim materials so the review can be finished cleanly. If the animal remains unsettled, it would also be reasonable to seek veterinary advice and to document any symptoms for follow-up. We regret that your trip required this additional burden, and we appreciate the patience it takes to raise a safety concern after travel.

We are sorry for the distress and are committed to a careful response.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
